run_mesh_info_extractor: run the script with a mesh filename to extract oriented bounding box data and print URDF collision XML
extract_mesh_position: extract the position (x, y, z) of a mesh's oriented bounding box center from a 3D file
extract_mesh_orientation: extract the Euler angle orientation of a mesh's oriented bounding box from a 3D file
extract_mesh_extents: extract the bounding box extents (width, height, depth) of a mesh from a 3D file
generate_urdf_collision_box: generate a URDF collision box XML snippet from a mesh file's oriented bounding box data
